main.description: An owned metering instrument: a handheld meter referencing its catalog.meterType, or a phone acting as a meter (kind 'phone-camera', identified by deviceModel). Instance conventions follow the other instance.* records. Calibration state lives in app.graycard.meter.calibration records that reference this instance, so recalibration never rewrites gear identity.

type.description: Optional app.graycard.catalog.meterType (handheld meters and cataloged apps).

kind.description: What sort of instrument this is. 'in-camera' lets a camera body's own meter be cited as a reading source.

camera.description: For kind 'in-camera': the app.graycard.instance.camera whose built-in meter this is.

deviceModel.description: For phone meters: hardware identifier, e.g. 'iPhone17,2'.
